description: Find elements in the renderer by accessibility role + name + state — no CSS selectors. Filters: role (exact), name_contains, name_exact, visible, enabled, interactive; limit caps the matches returned (count still reports the true total). Returns: { ok, surface_id, matches: [{ ref, role, name, bbox }], count, truncated, renderer_reloaded }. A ref may be null for non-interactive landmarks. Errors: NOT_RUNNING (no session — call electron_launch first; not retryable), BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions live — pass sessionId).

limit.description: Cap the matches returned (in document order); count still reports the true total so a truncation is detectable. Unset returns every match.

name_contains.description: Substring the accessible name must contain.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_find
title: Find elements by role and name
